name: teatime
flavor_text: The user has teatime with all the Pokémon currently in the battle. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.
effect_text_extend: All Pokemon on the field consume their held berries. This effect is not prevented by Substitute, Embargo, Magic Room, Klutz, or Unnerve. Fails if no active Pokemon is holding a berry.
effect_text_simple: All Pokemon on the field consume their held berries.
